title: Trailing tissue is the only tested damage-tolerant region
description: Survival across five phases and four rotations; 20 invariance trials per condition

source.label: Genesis replicated damage sweep

metricDefinitions.name: Survival rate
metricDefinitions.definition: Survival rate is the fraction of 20 phase-by-rotation invariance trials retaining mass of at least 1.0 after 300 post-damage steps.
metricDefinitions.calculationSummary: Five phases × four rotations per damage-location condition.

caveats: Rotations and phases test invariance but are not independent biological or evolutionary replicates.
Mean absolute removed-mass calibration error was 0.45 percentage points; maximum error was 1.94 points.

evidenceFlow.title: Controls
evidenceFlow.detail: All 20 undamaged controls retained between 99.0% and 100.1% of baseline mass.

evidenceFlow.title: Invariance
evidenceFlow.detail: Each phase produced 8 survivors and each orientation produced 10 survivors, matching the aggregate survival boundary.
